open_items: UNICEF recovered to healthy at cycle 942 after being degraded since cycle 921 (21 consecutive cycles: gateway data, direct data, direct json all HTTP 404, contract constraint:availableconstraint broken). Live recheck at this run confirmed the direct data path now returns 200. Watch one more cycle before fully retiring this memory, since a simultaneous clean recovery on both direct and gateway paths is unusual for this endpoint.

ILO flapped healthy -> gateway_issue -> healthy entirely between runs: gateway data probe got HTTP 403 from provider at cycle 941 only (direct checks unaffected), recovered by cycle 942. Matches the known single-cycle self-resolving ILO 403 pattern (e.g. cycle 874). Closed, no action needed.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 943: listing served without credentials. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.

More than 20 claude/ triage branches have accumulated on origin (56 counted at this run, up from 55 at cycle 940). Flagging per the skill's instruction so they can be pruned; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped). /api/contracts changes this cycle held only two cosmetic Content-Type parameter-order flaps (ABS and ILO encoding:structure_xml, charset/version ordering), verdict stayed ok both ways, not re-reportable per standing guidance.
